item.title: Trump says Iran 'afraid' to admit to talks; missiles fired to central Israel from Lebanon intercepted
item.description: Trump tells aides he wants to avoid prolonged war in Iran as US weighs next steps and doubts persist over talks; IDF completes series of strikes in Isfahan

item.title: Trump may announce Iran ceasefire by weekend, Israeli officials say
item.description: Officials believe US president could declare monthlong truce within days, prompting IDF to accelerate operations as Israel seeks to press ahead with its campaign until April 9; seizure of Iran’s strategic Kharg Island on the table if diplomacy fails

item.title: Why Iran’s missiles keep getting through: the weather factor Israel can’t control
item.description: After eight rounds of sirens from morning into the afternoon, analysts say heavy cloud cover, rain and fog over Iran may be hampering Israeli drone operations and helping Tehran sustain repeated launches toward central Israel

item.title: Katz says Israel killed Iran Revolutionary Guard navy chief amid Hormuz crisis
item.description: 'Important news for our American partners': defense minister says Alireza Tangsiri, blamed for mining operations and disrupting shipping in the strategic waterway, killed in strike as tensions mount over Iran’s threats to close the strait

item.title: At least 14 lightly hurt as Iran fires 8 barrages since morning, Hezbollah drone hits north
item.description: Strikes wound people in Tel Aviv, Kafr Qasem, Shaar Shomron, the Haifa Bay area and Liman, while cluster submunitions and debris damage homes, cars and a mall across central and northern Israel

item.title: Herzog slams Europe: 'Why are you so naive? You’re next' as he urges action on Iran
item.description: Israeli president says campaign protects Europe, criticizes UK and EU for inaction and calls Iran a 'rogue state'; also signals regime change is an unofficial goal of the war

item.title: IDF strikes Hamas commandos during drill as terror group tries to rebuild in Gaza
item.description: Military says overnight drone strike in central Gaza killed at least 4 Nukhba operatives during training session, as group seeks to reconstitute its elite force that led the Oct. 7 attacks

item.title: המלחמה מובילה להיערכויות אזוריות חדשות
item.description: נראה כי אין סכנה להסכמי השלום והנורמליזציה ששרדו את המלחמה בעזה, אולם ההידרדרות ביחסי ישראל עם מדינות האזור – במיוחד עם מצרים וירדן – תשפיע גם על מידת ההיתכנות של קידום הסכמי נורמליזציה עם מדינות נוספות באזור, ובמיוחד עם סעודיה, לאחר סיום המלחמה
